# dnsgate_record_sets (Data Source)

The RRsets of a zone with their ownership in the gate (the zone inventory), optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# RRsets of the zone not yet owned by the gate: candidates for adoption.
data "dnsgate_record_sets" "foreign" {
  zone   = "example.com"
  status = "foreign"
}

# ACME challenges of a team.
data "dnsgate_record_sets" "acme" {
  zone  = "example.com"
  name  = "_acme-challenge.*"
  type  = "TXT"
  owner = "web"
}

output "to_adopt" {
  value = [for rs in data.dnsgate_record_sets.foreign.record_sets : rs.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone name, for example `example.com`.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Glob on the name relative to the zone: `*` matches any characters (dots included), `?` one character; `@` is the apex. For example `_acme-challenge.*` or `*.apps`.
- `owner` (String) Keep only the RRsets owned by this team.
- `status` (String) Keep only this status: `managed`, `pending`, `tainted`, `foreign`, `missing`.
- `type` (String) Keep only this record type (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `record_sets` (Attributes List) Matching RRsets sorted by name then type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--record_sets))

<a id="nestedatt--record_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `record_sets`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (Attributes) Alias target, null for records with values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--record_sets--alias))
- `created_by` (String)
- `hash` (String) Content hash (the ETag of the RRset).
- `id` (String) `<zone>/<name>/<type>`, the import id of `dnsgate_record_set`.
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (String) Owner team, empty when not owned.
- `protected` (Boolean) Protected by the gate configuration: never written.
- `read_only` (String) Why the gate never writes this RRset, empty otherwise.
- `status` (String)
- `ttl` (Number) Null for aliases.
- `type` (String)
- `updated_by` (String)
- `values` (List of String) Sorted values, as the gate stores them.

<a id="nestedatt--record_sets--alias"></a>
### Nested Schema for `record_sets.alias`

Read-Only:

- `evaluate_target_health` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `zone_id` (String)
